name: Koi Shikaru-beki ~Mayoiga kara no Tegami~
original_name: 恋しかるべき　～迷い家からの手紙～
source: The setting is 50 years ago, Showa 47. The protagonist, a high school student, is heading to his grandparents’ countryside home. A short trip taken during summer vacation, a yearly tradition. Spending time with his sister, peacefully interacting with the villagers, but…
